messages:
maria: quick heads-up — I opened a tiny docs PR to fix the function-calling example that returns an array of objects. CI is failing on the link-checker. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4377
sam: thanks — what's failing?
maria: link-checker says /sdk/python/examples/parse_fallback.md -> 404. I moved the file in previous commit, forgot to update link in function-calling.md
jen: can you add a tiny TS snippet while you're there? SRE asked for a guarded parse example.
maria: yeah planning to: adding a 'parse fallback' example, plus a short TypeScript SDK usage and a Go minimal snippet. Want to keep examples < 12 lines.
alex: for the parse fallback, prefer showing both JSON schema and a simple fallback pseudo-code: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string"}},"required":["task"]}
``` then a 2-line parse try/catch.
maria: good. I'll also add a note about guardrails: encourage using strict schema + fallback to `parse_or_fallback(response)`
ci-bot: link-checker failed 1 item: /sdk/python/examples/parse_fallback.md -> 404
sam: assigned to @maria and @alex, can one of you pick up review? I can do quick pass once CI green. @jen can you confirm the wording for 'fallback'?
jen: yep — prefer 'graceful degradation' language, mention we log the raw response for eval.
maria: PR updated — added TS and Go snippets, fixed link, added fallback note, updated TOC. CI running: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/actions/runs/987654321
ci-bot: action run passed link-checker but lint shows a line wrap warning in function-calling.md: line 142 > 100 chars.
alex: small nit — TypeScript snippet should use `client.callTool(...)` not `client.invokeTool` (naming changed in SDK v0.8).
maria: fixed naming, re-pushed. Also added a one-line callout about 'avoid relying on specific array order' for tool outputs.
sam: LGTM from me once CI green. :thumbsup:
jen: small request — add test snippet for parser unit test (2 lines) showing expected output shape.
maria: added unit test example and a link to evals dashboard. Re-run CI.
ci-bot: all checks passed. Merged in main.
